why: The repository is public. Test fixtures must never carry the operator's account ids or the symbols of live holdings.
host_check: On a host that has persistent-state/data/portfolios/state/holdings.json the guard also checks the live held symbols and account ids (computed at test time, never committed).
preexisting_set: Derived at test time from `git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main -- tests/fixtures`; not listed here, so there is one source of truth and a fixture main gained from another branch can never be reported as this branch's leak. If origin/main cannot be resolved the guard fails closed with that reason.
